title: Future Continuous
summary: Use 'will be doing' to describe an action in progress at a specific future moment.

theory.markdown:
**Future Continuous** = **will be + verb-ing**

Use it for:
1. An action **in progress at a specific future time**: *At 8 pm tomorrow, I'll be watching the match.*
2. An action that will be **happening over a period** in the future: *This time next week, we'll be lying on a beach.*
3. Polite questions about someone's plans (less direct): *Will you be using the car tonight?*

**Compare:**
- *I will call you at 6.* (a single action)
- *I'll be working at 6, so call me later.* (an action in progress at 6)

theory.title: Future Continuous — forms
rows: She will be sleeping at midnight.
He won't be working tomorrow morning.
Will they be travelling this time next week?

exercises.prompt: At 9 pm I ___ (watch) the football match.
exercises.hint: Action in progress at a specific future moment.

exercises.prompt: This time next year, she ___ her degree.
exercises.explanation: 'This time next year' signals an action in progress at a future point -> Future Continuous.

exercises.source: They will be working on Sunday.
answers: They won't be working on Sunday.
They will not be working on Sunday.

exercises.source: Jutro o tej porze bedziemy podrozowac przez Europe.
answers: This time tomorrow we'll be travelling through Europe.
This time tomorrow we will be travelling through Europe.

exercises.prompt: ___ (Will / you / use) the car this evening? I need a lift.
exercises.hint: Polite question about future plans -> Future Continuous.

exercises.sentence: I will working from home all week.
answers: I will be working from home all week.

exercises.prompt: Don't call her at 3 pm — she ___ a meeting.
exercises.explanation: Action in progress at a specific future time -> will be + -ing.

exercises.prompt: This time next week, we ___ (lie) on the beach in Spain.
exercises.hint: Action in progress at a future point in time.

exercises.sentence: At midnight they will working still.
answers: At midnight they will still be working.
exercises.explanation: Future Continuous: will + be + -ing. 'Still' goes before 'be'.

exercises.source: Nie dzwon do mnie o osmej — bede jeszcze spac.
answers: Don't call me at eight — I'll still be sleeping.
Don't call me at 8 — I'll still be sleeping.

exercises.source: She will be cooking dinner at 7.
answers: Will she be cooking dinner at 7?
Will she be cooking dinner at 7 pm?

exercises.prompt: Will you be ___ the office tomorrow afternoon?
He ___ (travel) to Tokyo at this time tomorrow.
exercises.hint: In progress at a future moment -> will be + -ing.

exercises.source: Czy oni beda czekac, kiedy dotrzemy na lotnisko?
answers: Will they be waiting when we get to the airport?
Will they be waiting when we arrive at the airport?
